breakdown.description: The prompt replaces the uniform load by its single resultant for an exact deflection calculation, but equivalent resultants preserve force and moment, not the full beam-deflection response.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification correctly treats the load as a uniformly distributed load throughout ('The distributed load will be treated as a uniformly distributed load for all calculations'), rather than replacing it with a resultant force at midspan. This aligns with the ground truth prompt, which simply asks for deflection and slope under the UDL without any resultant substitution.
